evidence: src/explore_persona_space/experiments/sycophancy_onpolicy_612/judge_pass_612.py:146-147 — 'if out_path.exists(): return json.loads(out_path.read_text())' precedes the kappa<KAPPA_ACCEPT raise (lines 181-185); the FAIL report is written to disk BEFORE the raise (line 180), so any resume loads pass:false and continues silently. Fix: on cached load, raise unless report['pass'] is true. VM-side P6, zero GPU exposure; must land before P6 runs.

evidence: src/explore_persona_space/experiments/sycophancy_onpolicy_612/analyze_612.py:426 — 'k2_demote_to_descriptive: n_pass < 2'. Plan §7 K2: 'self-implant < +0.50 on >=2 sources at every checkpoint -> demote to descriptive'. 4-n_pass>=2 ⇔ n_pass<=2, so the n_pass==2 case (exactly 2 sources below floor) escapes the flag while 'pass' (n_pass>=3) is also false — limbo state. Fix: n_pass <= 2 (and ideally cross-check trajectory checkpoints per the 'at every checkpoint' wording). P7 advisory output, post-pod; fold into the p2j-p7 first-contact pass.
